setup.title: The Fox on Film
setup.style: Live-action, cinematic, natural light, a misty forest meadow at dawn, a riverside road, a darkroom lit by a red safelight and a cozy apartment; one continuous shot per prompt.

cast.name: Hana
cast.description: Hana, a woman in her twenties with a short black bob, wearing a mustard corduroy jacket over a white T-shirt, dark jeans and brown boots, with a single camera, a silver-and-black vintage film camera, on a brown leather strap.

cast.name: the fox
cast.description: the fox, a young red fox with a white chest, black socks and a bushy white-tipped tail.

extras.music: Warm fingerpicked acoustic guitar with a soft cello line.
extras.voice: Hana, speaking in voice-over, a woman in her twenties with a gentle, bright voice and a neutral American accent (S1),

shots.prompt: A wide shot of a misty forest meadow at dawn, where Hana walks through tall grass with her camera. Hana, a woman with a short black bob, in a mustard corduroy jacket, dark jeans and brown boots, carries a single camera, the silver-and-black vintage film camera on a brown leather strap around her neck. She opens its back, loads a roll of black-and-white film and winds it on with her thumb. The camera holds a wide shot with soft golden mist behind her.

variants.h3:

She opens its back, loads a roll of black-and-white film and winds it on with her thumb. The camera holds a wide shot with soft golden mist behind her. Hana, speaking in voice-over, a woman in her twenties with a gentle, bright voice and a neutral American accent (S1), says: <d>[English] Thirty-six frames. Let's find something worth one.</d> After this line the voice-over stays silent for the rest of the shot.

overall_soundscape: Birdsong, the click and whir of the film advance lever and grass brushing her boots.

non_diegetic_music: Warm fingerpicked acoustic guitar with a soft cello line.

shots.prompt: A medium shot of a muddy forest path at dawn, where Hana kneels over fresh paw prints. Hana, a woman with a short black bob, in her mustard corduroy jacket with her single vintage film camera on its brown leather strap around her neck, kneels and touches a line of small fresh fox paw prints in the mud. She looks toward a misty meadow ahead and follows the tracks quietly. The camera holds a low medium shot by the prints, then rises as she moves on.

shots.prompt: A wide shot of the meadow, where a red fox sits among wildflowers and Hana crouches at the edge. A young red fox with a white chest, black socks and a bushy white-tipped tail sits upright in the wet grass among small yellow wildflowers, facing the camera with its ears up and its tail curled around its front paws. At the edge of the meadow Hana, in her mustard corduroy jacket, slowly crouches and raises her single film camera to her eye. The camera holds a long lens shot with the fox sharp in the foreground and Hana soft behind.

shots.prompt: A close-up of Hana behind her vintage film camera, where she takes the picture. Hana, a woman with a short black bob, holds her single camera, the silver-and-black vintage film camera on its brown leather strap, focuses the lens with her fingertips, holds her breath and presses the shutter. Click. She lowers the camera with a delighted smile as, in the soft background, the red fox stands up from among the wildflowers and trots into the trees. The camera holds a close-up on her face and hands, then racks focus to the fox leaving.
